human_selection_text: Za mě jsou kandidáti A a B. A působí měkce, B působí elegantně, jednoduše. Na stránkách je aktuálně A, a v celkovém logu je taky spíš A. Takže volím A.
limitations: This is a selected wordmark direction candidate, not a final master.
Live-text rendering can vary across systems, including glyphs, metrics, kerning, spacing, and dimensions.
The exact font and its license and provenance must be resolved before any outline or master lock.
No symbol or lockup is included.
No runtime or public use is approved.
finalization_requirements: Decide whether Option A should become the final wordmark direction.
Select the exact font strategy: either document the exact typeface and license, or explicitly accept a live-text/system-font strategy with known variability.
If outlines are desired, approve a separate outline conversion task.
After final wordmark approval, create a separate wordmark master-lock PR.
After the wordmark master is locked, prepare light/dark lockup candidates using the locked symbol unchanged.
review_checklist: Confirm Option A remains the preferred direction for final wordmark consideration.
Assess the softer literary character and continuity with the current site and existing overall logo direction.
Review readability, uppercase/lowercase balance, kerning, and spacing across relevant environments.
Record live-text substitutions and rendering variation across relevant environments.
Resolve the exact font strategy, provenance, license, and permitted logo use.
Confirm that this candidate does not authorize a master, lockup, or runtime/public integration.
next_steps: Conduct final-direction review of Option A using this review-only candidate.
Document and approve the selected exact-font or accepted system-font strategy.
If requested and separately approved, evaluate outline conversion only after font provenance and license review.
Open a separate wordmark master-lock PR only after explicit final wordmark approval.
Prepare light/dark lockup candidates in a later separate task only after the wordmark master exists.
